effect_mechanism: These are the costs of establishing a hectare of mangrove, mostly by planting. A global database of 249 projects gives a median of $8,143 per hectare, with the middle range of projects between $1,434 and $47,935 [ev_project_cost_goto25_1], an earlier global meta-analysis gives a median of 1,097.16 USD/ha [ev_project_cost_su21_1], and a global cost-carbon study uses an average of US$4368 per hectare [ev_project_cost_jakovac20_3]. Country figures include 427.38 USD/ha (Bangladesh) and 150.00 USD/ha (Philippines) from practitioner records [ev_project_cost_wocat_4300_2019_establishment, ev_project_cost_wocat_578_2016_establishment], US$211/ha for community reforestation in the Philippines and US$946/ha in Thailand [ev_project_cost_hernmel17_4, ev_project_cost_hernmel17_3], 843 US dollars in northern Viet Nam [ev_project_cost_ifrc11_1], about USD 3,550 in Indonesia [ev_project_cost_wbidn22_1], and a modelled 7,700 USD/ha mean for Bangladesh [ev_project_cost_wbmang25_1].
